correctness.rationale: On 1<A<4, the Möbius conjugate y-A+A/y is positive-invariant for y>0 and has no negative periodic points. Rational iteration yields an explicit sextic whose discriminant has the sole threshold factor (A-3)^3 on this branch. At A=1 no real period-three orbit occurs, implying none for A<3. At A=3 the sextic is a doubled cubic with three distinct positive roots; at A=4 it has six positive simple roots, retained for 3<A<4. Exact invariant cubic factors, direct polynomial division and elementary symmetric expressions supply orbit multipliers; the unique flip threshold follows from 1-27d-25d^2-9d^3. An explicit invariant interval and classical Sharkovskii forcing give every least period from the established period three. Exact algebraic identities and rational brackets were replayed from the enclosed standalone checker, and no finite numerical test was treated as infinite proof.
